screen.nothing_hint: Start a recipe in Home Assistant

app.name: Chefkoch
app.summary: Cook along: the current recipe step large on the screen, with keys for back, timer and next.
app.opt_back_hint: The button that goes one step back (button.chefkoch_zuruck).
app.opt_next_hint: The button that goes to the next step (button.chefkoch_weiter).
app.opt_finish_hint: The button that ends cooking, shown on the last step (button.chefkoch_kochen_beenden).
app.opt_timer_hint: A script that starts the timer of the current step. Leave empty for no timer key.
